title: LangChain Testing Utilities
summary: This module provides base classes and utilities for unit and integration testing of various LangChain components, primarily focusing on chat models and vector stores, to ensure consistent behavior and feature support.

nodes.label: VCR Configuration
nodes.title: Base VCR Configuration
nodes.description: Provides base configuration for VCR (cassette library for HTTP interactions) in integration tests, handling sensitive data filtering and compression.

nodes.label: Chat Model Integration Tests
nodes.title: Comprehensive Chat Model Integration Tests
nodes.description: Defines integration tests for chat models, covering invoke, stream, batch, conversation, tool calling, structured output, multimodal inputs, and usage metadata.

nodes.label: Vector Store Integration Tests
nodes.title: Standard Vector Store Integration Tests
nodes.description: Provides integration tests for vector store implementations, including adding, deleting, and retrieving documents, and handling idempotency.

nodes.label: Chat Model Unit Tests
nodes.title: Core Chat Model Unit Tests
nodes.description: Framework for unit testing chat model initialization, environment variable loading, structured output configuration, standard parameter generation, and serialization.

groups.label: Chat Model Testing
groups.title: Chat Model Testing Framework
groups.description: Groups components related to testing the functionality and behavior of chat models, both at unit and integration levels.

groups.label: Vector Store Testing
groups.title: Vector Store Testing Framework
groups.description: Contains the base class for integration testing of vector store implementations, ensuring data persistence and retrieval correctness.

groups.label: Test Utilities
groups.title: General Testing Utilities
groups.description: Provides foundational utilities for testing, such as VCR configuration for recording HTTP interactions during integration tests.
